scholarships.name: Chevening Scholarships
scholarships.application_window: Applications typically open in August and close in early November.
scholarships.fields: Any subject at a UK university
scholarships.summary: The UK Government’s flagship global scholarship for future leaders. Scholars complete a one-year master’s at any UK university and join a worldwide network of Chevening alumni.
covers: Return economy flight to the UK
eligibility: Citizen of Sierra Leone (a Chevening-eligible country)
An undergraduate degree that qualifies you for a UK master’s programme
At least two years of work experience
Apply to three eligible UK master’s courses
Commit to returning to Sierra Leone for at least two years after the award
steps: Choose three eligible one-year master’s courses in the UK
Complete the online application with four essays (leadership, networking, study plans, career plan)
Provide two references and your academic documents
Shortlisted candidates are interviewed at the British High Commission
Secure an unconditional offer from one of your chosen universities

scholarships.name: Commonwealth Scholarships
scholarships.provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK
scholarships.fields: Subjects that support development in your home country
scholarships.summary: Funded by the UK Government for talented students from Commonwealth countries who could not otherwise afford to study in the UK. The focus is on study that contributes to development at home.
covers: Thesis and study travel grants (where applicable)
eligibility: Citizen of, or refugee in, an eligible Commonwealth country such as Sierra Leone
Usually an upper second-class (2:1) first degree or higher
Unable to afford to study in the UK without the scholarship
Nominated through your national nominating body or an approved nominating organisation
steps: Check which nominating body applies to you in Sierra Leone
Choose eligible UK courses and prepare your research or study plan
Apply online through the Commission’s system before the nominator’s deadline
Your nominating body shortlists candidates and forwards nominations
The Commission makes the final selection

scholarships.name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
scholarships.provider: U.S. Department of State, through the U.S. Embassy
scholarships.duration: Typically 1–2 years (master’s) or longer for PhD study
scholarships.summary: The U.S. Government’s international exchange programme for graduate students, young professionals and artists to study and conduct research at universities in the United States.
covers: Tuition (often shared with the host university)
eligibility: Citizen of Sierra Leone
A completed bachelor’s degree with a strong academic record
Good English proficiency (a test such as TOEFL may be required)
Apply through the U.S. Embassy in Freetown
steps: Check the current call for applications from the U.S. Embassy in Freetown
Prepare your study objectives, personal statement and references
Submit the online application before the embassy’s deadline
Attend an interview if shortlisted
Selected candidates are placed at U.S. universities

scholarships.name: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program
scholarships.summary: Comprehensive scholarships for academically talented young Africans facing financial barriers, at partner universities in Africa and around the world, with mentoring and leadership development.
eligibility: Young African with strong academic ability
Demonstrated financial need
Commitment to giving back to your community
Admission requirements of the partner university you apply to
steps: Review the list of partner universities and their programmes
Apply directly to the partner university’s scholars programme
Submit transcripts, essays and evidence of financial need
Complete any interviews or assessments

scholarships.name: DAAD Scholarships
scholarships.duration: Length of the programme (typically 1–2 years for a master’s)
scholarships.summary: Germany’s academic exchange service funds international students on postgraduate courses, including development-related master’s programmes for professionals from developing countries.
covers: Tuition is free at most public universities
eligibility: A bachelor’s degree, usually completed within the last six years
For many development-related courses, at least two years of relevant work experience
Meet the language requirements of the course (English or German)
steps: Search the DAAD scholarship database for programmes open to Sierra Leone
Choose eligible courses and check each course’s own deadline
Prepare a motivation letter, CV and references
Apply directly to the course, following DAAD instructions

scholarships.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters
scholarships.duration: 1–2 years across two or more countries
scholarships.summary: Prestigious master’s programmes delivered by consortia of European universities. Students study in at least two different countries and graduate with a joint or multiple degree.
eligibility: A bachelor’s degree or equivalent
Open to students from any country
Meet the specific requirements of the chosen programme
steps: Browse the Erasmus Mundus catalogue and pick up to three programmes
Check each programme’s entry requirements and deadline
Apply directly to the programme consortium
Selected students receive a scholarship offer from the consortium

scholarships.name: Chinese Government Scholarship
scholarships.duration: Length of the degree, often with a Chinese language year
scholarships.fields: Most subjects; many programmes taught in English
scholarships.summary: Full scholarships from the Chinese Government for international students at Chinese universities, available through bilateral programmes with embassies and directly through universities.
eligibility: Non-Chinese citizen in good health
Age limits usually apply (e.g. under 25 for bachelor’s, under 35 for master’s, under 40 for PhD)
Relevant previous qualification for the level you apply to
steps: Choose the application route: the Chinese Embassy (bilateral programme) or a university
Register on the Campus China portal and complete the online form
Upload certificates, transcripts, study plan and physical examination form
Submit your documents to the embassy or university by their deadline

scholarships.name: Türkiye Scholarships
scholarships.provider: Government of the Republic of Türkiye
scholarships.duration: Length of the degree plus a one-year Turkish language course
scholarships.application_window: Applications typically open in January and close in February.
scholarships.summary: A highly competitive government scholarship covering study at top Turkish universities, with a preparatory year of Turkish language and cultural programmes.
eligibility: Open to citizens of all countries
Age limits apply (typically under 21 for undergraduate, under 30 for master’s, under 35 for PhD)
Minimum academic scores apply (commonly 70% for undergraduate and master’s, 75% for PhD)
steps: Create an account on the Türkiye Scholarships application system
Choose up to twelve university programmes
Upload your documents and complete your statement of intent
Shortlisted applicants attend an interview

scholarships.name: Holland Scholarship
scholarships.provider: Dutch Ministry of Education and Dutch universities
scholarships.duration: One-off award in the first year
scholarships.summary: A one-off grant for international students from outside the European Economic Area starting a bachelor’s or master’s at a participating Dutch institution.
covers: One-time grant towards the first year of study (partial funding)
eligibility: Nationality of a country outside the European Economic Area
First time studying in the Netherlands
Admission to a participating bachelor’s or master’s programme
steps: Check which Dutch universities and programmes take part
Apply for admission to your chosen programme
Apply for the scholarship through the university by its deadline

scholarships.name: Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship
scholarships.fields: Undergraduate programmes at the University of Toronto
scholarships.summary: The University of Toronto’s most prestigious scholarship for international secondary-school students who show exceptional academic achievement, creativity and leadership.
covers: Full residence support for four years
eligibility: International student in the final year of secondary school (or recently graduated)
Exceptional academic achievement and creativity
Recognised as a leader in your school and community
Nominated by your school
steps: Ask your school to nominate you
Apply for admission to the University of Toronto
Submit the scholarship application once nominated

scholarships.name: ICCR Scholarships
scholarships.summary: Scholarships from the Government of India, including schemes for African students, to study at universities across India.
eligibility: Citizen of an eligible country, including African countries
Relevant previous qualification for the chosen level
Good English proficiency
steps: Register on the ICCR A2A scholarships portal
Choose up to five universities and courses
Upload documents and submit to the Indian mission accredited to Sierra Leone
